id.description: Stable slug, <manufacturer-slug>-<model-slug>. Never renamed once assigned.

name.description: Display name. Correctable without breaking id-based lookups.

manufacturer.description: Must match the vendor file this entry lives in (enforced by the validator, not this schema).

threads.description: Logical thread count. Omit when equal to cores (no SMT/hyperthreading).

memoryBandwidthGbps.description: Platform's rated max memory bandwidth in GB/s. For an Apple Silicon SoC, this is the unified-memory bandwidth (stands in for both CPU and GPU memory bandwidth, since they share one pool).
